messages.出門旅行或接到新任務時，你也許很快就會想：先做哪件事，大家才不必原地打轉。你願意: On a trip or with a new task, you may quickly ask what needs doing first so everyone can move forward. You are willing to decide and take responsibility at a crossroads. At your pace, though, others may not yet have voiced their concerns. The practice here is to make room for their steps along the road you see.
messages.乾卦借天的運行談持續向前的力量。那句自強不息，並不必讀成一刻都不能停；卦中既有尚: Qian uses the movement of heaven to explore sustained effort. Perseverance need not mean never stopping: its dragons also wait for the right moment and warn against going too far. Together these images suggest both advance and restraint—prepare without proving yourself, act when ready, and look back from a high point. They predict nobody's future; they invite you to ask whether this step needs courage or patience.
